title: Evaluation requested
description:
This event occurs asynchronously when the platform completes an evaluation request of a flex control. The event contains information about the evaluated parameters and the result of the evaluation.
More information: Flexible transaction controls

method.title: The HTTP Method of address register operation

uri.title: The URI of address register operation

email.title: The email of operator that registered address

roles.title: The roles of operator that registered address

origin.title: The request origin of address register operation

amount.title: The amount of the payment transaction.

currency_code.title: The currency code based on ISO-4217.

accounts.title: The accounts related to the transaction

from.title: The account the transaction originated from

processing_code.title: The Processing Code of the transaction.
The Processing Code of the transaction.

merchant_category_code.title: A Merchant Category Code (MCC) is a four-digit number listed in ISO 18245 for retail financial services.

entry_mode.title: The entry mode are numeric or string codes that identify the method a card transaction was captured.

simulation.title: The evaluation request is for simulating evaluation.

force.title: Force to evaluate true due to Anti-Fraud decision.

tracking_id.title: The tracking id of the request.

country_code.title: The country where the transaction originated. The country code is a three-letter code defined by ISO 3166-1.

number_of_installments.title: Number of installments in the operation.

is_password_present.title: Is password present
is_password_present.description: Is password present in the transaction?

is_pin_validated_offline.title: Is pin validated offline
is_pin_validated_offline.description: Is pin validation performed offline during authorization? When configured as a reset trigger, accumulators reset based on this boolean value.

is_physical_card_present.title: Flag that indicates whether a physical card is present.

card_mode.title: Specifies the operational mode of the card.
card_mode.description: Specifies the operational mode of the card.

is_device_registered.title: Is device registered
is_device_registered.description: Indicates whether the device used for the operation is registered according to the financial institution's security policies.

is_tra_exemption_requested.title: Is TRA exemption requested?
is_tra_exemption_requested.description: Indicates whether a TRA (Transaction Risk Assessment) exemption is requested for the transaction.

is_token_present.title: Indicates whether the token is present in the evaluation request.

initiation_mode.title: Initiation mode
initiation_mode.description:
Initiation mode.
-`moto`: Payments made through mail order or telephone.
- `mit`: Merchant-initiated transactions.

authentication_method.title: Authentication methods
authentication_method.description: List of authentication methods that should trigger a reset of the flex control accumulator.

acquirer_country_code.title: Acquirer country code
acquirer_country_code.description: Acquirer country code based on the ISO 3166-1 standards. It can be represented in one of the following formats: - Alpha-2: Two-letter country code (for example, "BR" for Brazil). - Alpha-3: Three-letter country code (for example, "BRA" for Brazil). - Numeric: Three-digit country code (for example, "076" for Brazil).

is_cavv_present.title: Is CAVV present
is_cavv_present.description: Indicates whether the CAVV is present in the evaluation request. CAVV stands for cardholder authentication verification value.

avr.title: AVR
avr.description: String indicating that the transaction is a card network Account Verification Request (AVR) transaction. AVR transactions differ from standard authorizations in that they are typically zero-value and are used for card network verification flows. Currently, the only supported value for this attribute is `mtt`, which is the Mobility & Transport Transaction (MTT) type.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Type of operation being performed, allowing differentiation between debit and credit transactions.

result.title: Evaluation result
result.description: Indicates whether the flex controls evaluation resulted in approval (`true`) or denial (`false`).

deny_code.title: Deny code
deny_code.description: Deny code explains why the evaluation is denied. You can configure this code when creating a flex control.

custom_code.title: Custom code
custom_code.description: Alphanumeric three-character custom code and can be the alternative custom code. Alternative custom code overrides the standard platform custom code and provides the reason set in the alternative custom code. When the platform denies a control evaluation, the custom code provides the denial code.

message.title: Message
examples: [dd9ff885-14da-40e6-8b54-bb56fce06936] Got value '22095' and the rule value is '1'.

response_code.title: Response code
response_code.description: Alphanumeric two-character response code. This can be the standard card network response code or an alternative custom response code. When the platform denies a control evaluation, the platform returns the response code that provides the precise reason for the denial by the card network or anti-fraud solution.

result.title: Result
result.description: Indicates whether the flex controls evaluation resulted in approval (`true`) or denial (`false`).

message.title: Message
examples: [dd9ff885-14da-40e6-8b54-bb56fce06936] Got value '22095' and the rule value is '1'.

deny_code.title: Deny code
deny_code.description: Deny code related to the restriction. This code is returned when the evaluation does not meet the conditions.

custom_code.title: Custom code
custom_code.description: Alphanumeric three-character custom code and can be the alternative custom code. Alternative custom code overrides the standard platform custom code and provides the reason set in the alternative custom code. When the platform denies a control evaluation, the custom code provides the denial code.

response_code.title: Response code
response_code.description: When the platform denies a control evaluation, the platform returns a response code indicating the card network's or anti-fraud solution's denial reason.

max_limit.title: Max limit
max_limit.description: Max flex control limit. Once met or exceeded, the evaluation control flow declines any further transactions.

available_limit.title: Available limit
available_limit.description: Flex control for total available limit. The value is the difference of `max_limit` and `current_spend_limit`.

max_amount.title: Maximum accumulated amount
max_amount.description: Maximum allowed accumulated amount. Once exceeded, the evaluation control flow declines subsequent transactions. Applies only to cumulative flex controls.

available_amount.title: Current available amount
available_amount.description: Current available amount. The amount available is updated as the Pismo platform evaluates flex controls. The value for `available_amount` is deducted or reset according to `entry_mode` and `reset_strategy`. Applies only to cumulative flex controls.

max_transactions.title: Max transactions allowed
max_transactions.description: Max transactions allowed. Applies only to cumulative flex controls.

available_transactions.title: Current available transactions
available_transactions.description: Current available transactions. The number of available transactions reduces by 1 after each transaction or resets according to `entry_mode` and `reset_strategy`. Applies only to cumulative flex control.
